sources.name: GEMI — General Commercial Registry public search (Γ.Ε.ΜΗ.)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. Official GEMI publicity search: by AFM (tax ID), GEMI number, name, legal form, status, location, incorporation date. Server-rendered form, per-company announcement pages. No public bulk API advertised on-page; per-entity scraping route is feasible.

sources.name: data.gov.gr — National Open Data Portal (incl. business/registry datasets)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. 22,315 datasets, 487 orgs, documented API (data-gov-gr.gitbook.io guides) plus bulk download; 'Economy & financial' theme and high-value entrepreneurship datasets. Best machine route to registry-derived data.

sources.name: ELSTAT — Hellenic Statistical Authority (business registers & SBS)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. Structural business statistics, business registries/administrative registers, high-value open datasets, press-release RSS advertised on site (rssUrl is the advertised link, feed itself not fetched).

sources.name: HCMC — Hellenic Capital Market Commission registers (AIFMs/AEDOEE, UCITS ManCos, investment firms)
sources.verdict: CONFIRMED GEO-BLOCKED: connection refused from outside Greece (ECONNREFUSED on hcmc.gr), matching prior reports. Registers of Greek AIFMs, ManCos, investment firms exist behind it. Workaround: Greek IP/proxy or ESMA mirrors (next entries).

sources.name: ESMA AIFMD register (Greek AIFMs mirror)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED reachable; CSV export offered but volume-capped and CAPTCHA appears on some queries. Reliable substitute for geo-blocked HCMC AIFM register; filter Member State = GR.

sources.name: ESMA interim MiCA register (Greek CASPs)
sources.verdict: PARTIALLY VERIFIED: my fetch of a slug variant returned 404; ESMA publishes the interim MiCA register as a downloadable spreadsheet (HCMC is Greece's CASP authority). Confirm exact current URL before wiring.

sources.name: Bank of Greece — supervised institutions registers (banks, credit servicing firms/NPL servicers, payment & e-money institutions)
sources.category: central bank registers incl. NPL servicers
sources.verdict: HTTP 403 to automated fetch (bot protection), but this is the canonical home of the Greek credit-servicing-firm (NPL servicer) list — core private-debt coverage. Needs browser-grade crawler or manual pulls; lists are typically PDF/HTML.

sources.name: Bank of Greece — Private Insurance Supervision (register of insurance undertakings)
sources.verdict: Same 403 bot-block as rest of bankofgreece.gr. BoG (DEIA) is the Greek insurance supervisor; register exists behind block. EIOPA register is the fallback mirror.

sources.name: EBA credit institutions register (EUCLID) — Greek banks mirror
sources.verdict: NOT fetch-verified this session; EBA's EUCLID/PSD2 registers are known to expose downloadable/API data covering Greek credit and payment institutions. Use as workaround for blocked BoG pages.

sources.name: EIOPA register of insurance undertakings — Greece mirror
sources.verdict: NOT fetch-verified this session. Known EIOPA register covering Greek insurers/intermediaries; fallback for the 403-blocked BoG insurance register.

sources.name: ELTE — Hellenic Accounting & Auditing Oversight Board (registers of audit firms & CPAs)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. National audit oversight authority; maintains public registers of certified audit firms, CPAs, and licensed foreign audit firms — fund-auditor coverage for the institutional service graph.

sources.name: Ministry of Finance — Register of Certified Valuers (Μητρώο Πιστοποιημένων Εκτιμητών)
sources.verdict: Ministry domain is real but the register page itself was NOT verified this session (ministry site recently migrated). The certified-valuer register (real-asset appraisers) is legally maintained by MinFin — locate current path before wiring.

sources.name: National Actuarial Authority (occupational pension funds / TEA oversight)
sources.verdict: HTTP 403 to automated fetch; domain live. Supervises occupational insurance funds (TEA) — the domestic institutional LP layer. Fund lists likely PDF.

sources.name: National Printing House — FEK official gazette search
sources.verdict: VERIFIED via et.gr: dedicated FEK/KAD search portal; issues downloadable, cryptographically signed PDFs since 2006. Corporate acts (esp. pre-GEMI and fund/SPV notices) publish here.

sources.name: Diavgeia transparency portal + open data API
sources.verdict: VERIFIED: opendata endpoint returned valid JSON (organizations with VAT numbers, categories, supervisors). Full decision-search API; every public-sector act (grants, concessions, appointments, procurement awards) is here. Note: UI showed temporary maintenance limiting UI search to ADA only — API still served data.

sources.name: Electronic Solvency Register (Ηλεκτρονικό Μητρώο Φερεγγυότητας)
sources.verdict: NOT REACHABLE from this environment: DNS ENOTFOUND (both with/without www) — likely GR-only resolution/geo-fencing. This is the statutory insolvency publicity register under L.4738/2020; retest from Greek IP.

sources.name: EGDIX — Special Secretariat for Private Debt Management (insolvency administrators register, out-of-court workout stats)
sources.verdict: Connection refused from outside Greece (ECONNREFUSED) — geo-block. Hosts the roll of licensed insolvency administrators (διαχειριστές αφερεγγυότητας) and private-debt statistics. Greek IP required.

sources.name: Hellenic e-Procurement portal (ESIDIS/KIMDIS — promitheus.gov.gr)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED redirect promitheus.gov.gr → portal.eprocurement.gov.gr, but portal rendered blank to the fetcher (JS SPA). Procurement notices also flow through Diavgeia (API) and EU TED — use those for machine access.

sources.name: Athens Exchange Group (ATHEX) — listed companies, members, announcements
sources.verdict: HTTP 403 to automated fetch (bot protection) on multiple paths incl. company lists. Issuer list, member list, and company announcement feed exist behind it; needs browser-grade crawling or vendor feed. REITs (AEEAP) and listed holdcos live here.

sources.name: Elevate Greece — national startup registry
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. Official state-accredited startup database with searchable directory (the-startup-database route) — the cleanest public census of Greek VC-backed/VC-able companies.

sources.name: HVCA — Hellenic Venture Capital & Private Equity Association
sources.verdict: HTTP 403 to automated fetch (site historically flaky/TYPO3 as hinted; retried, still blocked to bots). Member directory of Greek GPs exists on the site — retry with browser-grade fetch.

sources.name: ETHE — Union of Institutional Investors (fund & asset managers association) + data portal
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. ~40+ member ManCos/AEDAK displayed with categories; quarterly market statistics and a dedicated stats database at data.ethe.org.gr. Strong liquid-alts/fund coverage.

sources.name: Hellenic Bank Association — member banks
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. 24 members (10 regular, 14 associate), members section + press releases. Anchor for the credit-institution side.

sources.name: EAEE — Hellenic Association of Insurance Companies
sources.verdict: HTTP 403 to automated fetch; association is real and publishes member lists and premium statistics. Needs browser-grade fetch.

sources.name: Hellenic Factors Association — member factoring companies
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. Members listed on-page: ABC Factors, BFF, Eurobank Factors, NBG Factors, Credia Factors, Piraeus Factoring, Optima Factors (+ Pancreta 2024). Direct trade-finance entity source.

sources.name: SEV — Hellenic Federation of Enterprises
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. Research & publications section, member news, economic bulletins. Corporate-side context and member signals; no full public member directory visible.

sources.name: Enterprise Greece — investment promotion agency
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. National FDI/trade agency under MFA; strategic-investments framework pages, press releases, events. Strategic-investment approvals are deal signals.

sources.name: Growthfund (HCAP) — National Fund of Greece
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. EUR 12.3B AuM, 23 subsidiaries/participations, real estate + concessions; tender and appointment news flow. Successor umbrella for privatization pipeline.

sources.name: HRADF / TAIPED (privatization agency — archived)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED with caveat: site explicitly no longer updated; redirects users to Growthfund and the PPF platform under Growthfund. Keep only as historical tender archive.

sources.name: Hellenic Development Bank (HDB)
sources.verdict: HTTP 403 to automated fetch; institution real (guarantee/co-financing programs channeled via banks). Program announcements are credit-market signals.

sources.name: HDBI — Hellenic Development Bank of Investments (sovereign fund-of-funds, ex-TANEO)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. Self-described Sovereign Fund of Funds of Greece; portfolio page (about-hdbi/portfolio-2) lists the Greek VC/PE funds it anchors — a public map of the domestic GP universe and its LP.

sources.name: HFSF — Hellenic Financial Stability Fund
sources.verdict: Fetch failed (socket closed) this session; fund is real (systemic-bank stakes, divestment reports). Retry; note HFSF has been merging into Growthfund.

sources.name: EBRD — Greece country page & project database
sources.verdict: NOT fetch-verified this session; EBRD project summary documents database is a known public, filterable source of Greek deals and fund commitments.

sources.name: EIF — EquiFund & Greek fund commitments

sources.verdict: NOT fetch-verified this session. EquiFund (EIF-managed) seeded most of the current Greek VC generation; EIF publishes intermediary lists. Confirm current URL.

sources.name: Athens Bar Association (DSA) — member search

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Thin-to-moderate Greece coverage: the handful of institutional Greek GPs (mostly EquiFund-era VCs and a few PE/infra managers), Greek exposure of pan-European funds, and some LP records (HDBI, insurance groups). Weak on NPL servicers, service graph, and non-fund entities.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: HCMC AIFM lists (via Greek access), ESMA registers, HDBI/EIF EquiFund portfolio disclosures, fund manager websites and press releases — all reachable directly (ESMA + HDBI portfolio page + press).

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Deal-level coverage of Greek PE/VC and M&A, decent on larger buyouts (CVC/BC Partners activity in Greece), valuations mostly modeled. Weak on private debt/NPL trades and real-asset SPVs.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Press (Kathimerini/Capital/Naftemporiki English wires), ATHEX announcements, GEMI filings for cap-table confirmation, EU/EIF and EBRD project disclosures — GEMI, ATHEX, Diavgeia and EBRD project docs are directly accessible.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Strongest global platform for the Greek startup/VC layer; powers or overlaps with the annual 'Startups in Greece' reporting (with Found.ation/Marathon ecosystem actors). Company-level coverage broad, funding data crowdsourced+press.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Elevate Greece registry, The Recursive and Greek startup press, EIF/EquiFund fund lists, founder self-reporting — Elevate Greece and The Recursive RSS are direct routes.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Broad but shallow Greek company/round coverage, self-reported and press-driven; frequent gaps and stale entries outside VC.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Press releases, company self-submissions, TechCrunch-style media — the underlying Greek press (verified RSS set above) is directly ingestable.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Deepest Greek firmographics: credit ratings, financial statements, sector studies, business directories covering the whole corporate universe incl. servicers and real-estate companies. Paid; the de facto local Preqin-for-firmographics.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: GEMI/businessportal filings and financial statements, FEK (et.gr) corporate acts, court/protest data, ELSTAT — GEMI publicity search, search.et.gr and ELSTAT are all directly accessible public feeds.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Greek business information and sector risk reports; company financials and demographics. Similar public underpinnings to ICAP at smaller scale.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: GEMI filings, FEK, ELSTAT business registers — all direct.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Bank-owned credit bureau: defaults, bounced cheques, credit profiles. Not publicly accessible (bank/consent-gated) — relevant as the reason public insolvency signals must come from solvency.gov.gr, Diavgeia and FEK instead.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Court registries, protested bills, bank submissions — the public slice we can reach directly is the Electronic Solvency Register and FEK insolvency notices.

searchedButAbsent: Session constraint disclosed: the WebSearch budget was exhausted before this task began, so discovery was WebFetch-verification of known/hinted URLs rather than fresh search fan-out. Absent or unreachable despite attempts: (1) no public Greek UBO register route — Central UBO Registry access is restricted post-CJEU; (2) no standalone fund-administrator licensee list — administration falls under HCMC/BoG perimeters, and HCMC is geo-blocked (connection refused from non-GR IPs); (3) no Greek litigation-funding register or association found; (4) solvency.gov.gr (insolvency register) did not resolve via DNS from this environment and keyd.gov.gr (insolvency-administrator roll) refused connections — both need a Greek IP; (5) no working RSS could be confirmed for Kathimerini, eKathimerini, Capital.gr, Euro2day, Naftemporiki, AMNA, or Athens Exchange — all bot-blocked (403) or 404 on standard feed paths, though the outlets themselves are real; (6) no public register of occupational pension funds (TEA) holdings — only the National Actuarial Authority (403 to bots) and Ministry of Labour PDFs; (7) no dedicated Greek leasing-association web directory verified (association exists but no reliable URL confirmed, so it was excluded rather than padded); (8) Bank of Greece domain (all registers + press) returns 403 to automated fetchers — content exists but needs browser-grade crawling; (9) GEMI exposes no advertised public bulk API on the publicity portal — data.gov.gr API is the closest open bulk route.
